_meta.rule_under_test: R4 (lot number absent) + R5 (CoA not referenced) + R5b (IR spectra not referenced)
_meta.direction: NEGATIVE (should FLAG — multiple flag reasons on ONE finding, only 1 flagged finding in section → stays FLAG)
_meta.description: Two S.5 findings for the same submission. F-030 has a rationale that mentions the working standard and source but omits lot number (R4 fires), CoA (R5 fires), and overlaid IR spectra (R5b fires) — three flag reasons on ONE finding. F-031 is a clean PASS: it includes lot number, CoA, IR spectra, working standard, and source. Because F-030 carries 3 flag reasons but only 1 finding is FLAGGED in section 3.2.S.5, the section-escalation threshold (≥2 flagged findings) is NOT met. Status stays FLAG. This scenario demonstrates that the section escalation counts distinct FLAGGED FINDINGS, not the number of flag reasons on a single finding.
_meta.author: M5
